# coeff-field-tc (2026-11-17)

**Result.** The open hypothesis `eigenformCoeffFieldFinite` (`DSCoeffExt.EigenformCoeffFieldFinite`:
`K_f = ℚ(a_n(f))` is finite over `ℚ` for a normalized eigenform `f ∈ S_k(N, χ)`, Diamond–Shurman
Def. 5.8.1, `k ≥ 2`) is proved outright, with no new hypothesis:

```lean
theorem eigenformCoeffFieldFinite_proof : DSCoeffExt.EigenformCoeffFieldFinite
```

in `ZInQKernel/Contrib/OneProof/EigenformCoeffFieldFiniteProof.lean`. `#print axioms` gives
`[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

**Input.** Tau Ceti proves that the `ℤ`-algebra generated by the prime-index Hecke operators on
`S_k(Γ₁(N))` is a finite `ℤ`-module in weight at least two (`TauCeti.heckeTCuspPrimeAlgebra_finite`,
`NumberTheory/ModularForms/HeckeSlash/Finite.lean`, from the finite module of integral modular symbols
and the injective period map), and that the Fourier coefficients of a normalised full eigenform are
algebraic integers (`Newforms/NumberField.lean`). Neither was vendored. This task vendors the 37 modules of the closure of
`TauCeti.NumberTheory.ModularForms.Newforms.NumberField` that were missing (commit 5a01f5fe, the commit of the other
vendored modules; list in `scratch/coeff-field-tc/vendor-new.txt`; `ThirdParty/TauCeti/NOTICE` updated). They compile
against the pinned Mathlib as they are; one of them, `RingTheory/MvPolynomial/Homogeneous.lean`, has one compatibility
change (a lemma made `private`, see "Name clash" below).

**Proof.** `EigenformCoeffFieldFiniteProof.finiteDimensional_adjoin_qExpansion_coeff` is Tau Ceti's
`TauCeti.numberField_CoefficientField` (stated for newforms) generalised to every normalised full
eigenform and to the field of all coefficients, `n = 0` included: a finite `ℤ`-generating set of
the prime-index Hecke algebra and the finitely many nebentypus values generate a finite extension
`K` of `ℚ`; `K` contains every `a_p` (the eigenvalue of `T_p`, at the primes dividing the level too)
and every `χ(p) p^{k−1}`, hence every `a_n` by `Eigenform.qExpansion_coeff_mem_of_forall_prime`.
The kernel's `IsNormalizedEigenformDS f χ` supplies the Tau Ceti eigenform `F` with
`F.toCuspForm = f` and `a₁ = 1`, and `coeffField f` is the field of all coefficients of `f`. The
file carries Tau Ceti's copyright header and an Apache-2.0 §4(b) modification line.

**Relation to wip/coeff-field.** That branch reduces the same field to two new printed leaves
(`Gamma1IntegralSpan`, Shimura 1971 Thm 3.52, and `DiamondIntegralToRational`). This proof needs
neither: the integrality comes from Tau Ceti's modular symbols.

**Checks.** On a fresh checkout of main at 222c98bf (Lean v4.35.0, Mathlib 56a00585):
`lake build ZInQKernel.Contrib.OneProof.EigenformCoeffFieldFiniteProof` succeeded (9644 jobs, no
error, no `sorry`); `#print axioms eigenformCoeffFieldFinite_proof` as above. `lake build +ZInQKernel.OneProof.Main
+ZInQKernel.OneProof.Discharges +ZInQKernel.Contrib.OneProof.EigenformCoeffFieldFiniteProof` succeeded (14265 jobs).
`#discharges` (`scratch/coeff-field-tc/discharges-output.txt`) reports
`DISCHARGES [OpenResearchLeaves31.eigenformCoeffFieldFinite] by eigenformCoeffFieldFinite_proof`, `still assumes: []`,
axioms `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

**Name clash.** The first `#discharges` run failed to import the contribution next to `Main`: the vendored
`RingTheory/MvPolynomial/Homogeneous.lean` declares `MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.eval₂_const_mul`, and the environment
of `Main` already contains a declaration of that name (from
`ZInQKernel.Contrib.CloudW07JacobiansCurves.Jacobian.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.HomogeneousCharts`, as the import error
says). A check of all 572 declarations of the 37 new modules against the environment of
`Main` + `Discharges` found no other clash. The vendored copy now makes that lemma `private` (its only uses are in the
same file), with a "Modified for the Z-in-Q kernel" line and a NOTICE entry.

**Fold (current main).** Since this proof was written, coeff-rational's fold (`TailZ56`) replaced the field
`eigenformCoeffFieldFinite` of `OpenResearchLeaves31` by the leaves `gamma1IntegralSpan` and
`heckePrimeIntegralToRational`. They are read in two places only, both through
`CoeffRational.eigenformCoeffFieldFinite_of_heckePrime n.gamma1IntegralSpan n.heckePrimeIntegralToRational`:
`TailZ56`'s conversion (the field `eigenformCoeffFieldFinite`) and the `r17` line of `TailZ57`'s; in `TailZ58`–`TailZ62`
they are passed through. `TailZ63` (generated by `scratch/coeff-field-tc/gen_fold.py`) copies the research generations
`OpenResearchLeaves32`–`38` and their conversions from `TailZ56`–`TailZ62` with the two fields and their pass-through
lines deleted and both readings replaced by `eigenformCoeffFieldFinite_proof` (renaming `OpenResearchLeaves<j> ↦
OpenResearchLeaves<j>CF`, `OpenResearchLeaves38 ↦ OpenResearchLeaves39`); every other line is copied verbatim and the
originals are unchanged. `sixContactMin_of_open56` goes through the copies to `sixContactMin_of_open48`, and
`frozenTarget` takes `OpenResearchLeaves39`. The two rows are removed from `kinds.tsv`. No new leaf.
